description: Review and analyze a personal sell-or-hold decision for rental property against a stock or fixed-income alternative. Use when the user asks whether to sell rental condos or houses and move the money into investments, when comparing rent yield with fixed income, when modeling a 3-year sell-or-hold scenario with break-even returns, or when checking a personal investment assessment document. Covers Canadian tax concepts (Capital Cost Allowance (CCA), terminal loss, principal residence, personal-use losses) where the owner is a Canadian resident. Triggers: sell or hold, rental yield, net yield, cash flow, break-even, condo, strata fee, property tax, CCA, fixed income, ETF, concentration, 售房, 持有, 租金收益率, 固定收益.
